title: Structure and mechanism of the gamma-secretase intramembrane protease complex.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究γ-分泌酶跨膜蛋白复合物的结构与机制，属于膜内蛋白酶水解，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合体系完全无关。
abstract: gamma-Secretase is a membrane protein complex that proteolyzes within the transmembrane domain of >100 substrates, including those derived from the amyloid precursor protein and the Notch family of cell surface receptors. The nine-transmembrane presenilin is the catalytic component of this aspartyl protease complex that carries out hydrolysis in the lipid bilayer. Advances in cryoelectron microscopy have led to the elucidation of the structure of the gamma-secretase complex at atomic resolution. Recently, structures of the enzyme have been determined with bound APP- or Notch-derived substrates, providing insight into the nature of substrate recognition and processing. Molecular dynamics simulations of substrate-bound enzymes suggest dynamic mechanisms of intramembrane proteolysis. Structures of the enzyme bound to small-molecule inhibitors and modulators have also been solved, setting the stage for rational structure-based drug discovery targeting gamma-secretase.
abstract_zh: γ-分泌酶（gamma-secretase）是一种膜蛋白复合物，可在超过100种底物的跨膜结构域内进行蛋白水解，这些底物包括源自淀粉样前体蛋白（amyloid precursor protein）和Notch家族细胞表面受体的底物。九次跨膜的早老素（presenilin）是该天冬氨酸蛋白酶复合物的催化组分，负责在脂质双层中进行水解。冷冻电子显微镜（cryoelectron microscopy）的进展已使γ-分泌酶复合物结构在原子分辨率下得以阐明。近期，已确定了酶与APP或Notch来源底物结合的结构，为底物识别和加工的本质提供了见解。底物结合酶的分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟提示了膜内蛋白水解的动态机制。酶与小分子抑制剂和调节剂结合的结构也已解析，为基于结构的合理药物设计靶向γ-分泌酶奠定了基础。
